accepted_visible_direction.layout: forty real pfRaid buttons at the provider's 10x4 VERTICAL density; no shared outer frame or decorative raid background
accepted_visible_direction.metaphor: compact hand-cut expedition muster slips made from reused saddle, shield-strap and tent-binding leather
accepted_visible_direction.material_hierarchy: thin deep-walnut leather edge over a quiet soot-brown liner, with only sparse dull-brass or stitch repairs
accepted_visible_direction.silhouette: four equally weighted complete shell variants with low-frequency hand-cut differences; the individual member remains thin
accepted_visible_direction.palette: low-saturation smoke brown, deep walnut and restrained oxidized brass under warm upper-left light
accepted_visible_direction.visual_weight: weight comes from the forty-member formation and repeated dark material, not forty thick cards
accepted_visible_direction.integration: existing accepted Health and Power material remains the live-bar layer; names, icons and states remain provider-owned
accepted_visible_direction.state_impression: hover and aggro read as short broken edge responses while range, offline, resurrection, aura and vanilla glyph density stays legible

included_objects: per-member health and power status bars
hover, aggro, combat, range, offline and resurrection presentation
buff/debuff indicators and existing vanilla functional glyphs
optional raid group labels when raidgrouplabel=1
excluded_objects: unit data, click-cast, roster sorting, events and SavedVariables

architecture.metaphor: forty compact hand-cut leather roster slips clipped into one expedition muster formation

member_shell.assignment: deterministic by pfRaid slot; roster changes never reshuffle art
member_shell.horizontal_resize: derive a three-slice from each accepted complete source; unique repairs stay in fixed caps
member_shell.vertical_resize: current 33px provider height only; unsupported out-of-profile height fails open to pfUI
member_shell.unified_ui_scale: safe because the provider button and all shell/state textures share the same parent scale

bars.background: smoke-brown shell liner revealed by unfilled status-bar width

state_art.hover_and_aggro: short irregular tintable edge responses derived from accepted shell alpha; never a full neon rectangle
state_art.combat_square: tiny torn-pigment corner pip when the provider option is enabled
state_art.vanilla_glyphs: leader, master-looter and raid-target glyph identities remain dynamic and are not baked
state_art.aura_rim: one-pixel soot-dark support around live aura/debuff icons; icons remain provider-owned

optional_group_label.future_art: one quiet rough cloth/leather tally slip behind the existing dynamic Group N FontString

variant_direction.A: 左上有一处钝缺口，右下两针长短不齐
variant_direction.B: 右上单枚偏心暗铆钉，下缘被反复磨旧
variant_direction.C: 左缘一块短皮补片，不出现亮金属
variant_direction.D: 右上歪斜暗铜短修补，左下保留一道裂口

locked_references.inherit: circa-2004 painted scale, warm upper-left light, material thickness and rough wear
locked_references.ignore: book, page, spine, channel tab and complete frame geometry

locked_references.inherit: deep walnut depth, hand-made error and restrained dull-brass response
locked_references.ignore: pages, columns, dragons and broad book construction

authoritative: forty actual pfRaid objects and 10x4 VERTICAL placement
70x33 button, 70x30 health, one-pixel gap and 70x2 power geometry
no shared outer panel and no change to click or roster behavior
four low-noise member-shell identities distributed deterministically
existing accepted health/power runtime textures represented at actual bar sizes
representative live state density, z-order and range/offline alpha
non_authoritative: final painted pixels, alpha edge quality and source extraction
production canvas, exact repair anatomy and final runtime atlas packing
optional Group N backing because raidgrouplabel is currently disabled
target-device SavedVariables and physical screen placement beyond the repository profile
